label: Aristotle, Physics III.1, 201a10-11…: Change is the actuality of what exists potentially, insofar…
interpretation: Relation-preserving definitional reading: an occurrence is change exactly when it is the actuality of some subject that exists potentially, precisely qua potential. Potential existence and the compound actuality/qua-potential relation remain primitive, so the claim does not decide between product-like actuality, process-like actualization, or manifested-potentiality analyses and adds no target state, time, mover, completion, or category.
